rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for transmitting a programme, message, or signal by radio, television, or electronic means.

example.english: The radio station will broadcast the typhoon news now.
example.traditional: 而家電台會廣播颱風消息。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 din6 toi4 wui5 gwong2 bo3 toi4 fung1 siu1 sik1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the radio or TV transmission itself.

example.english: The broadcast signal is very weak right now.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 go3 gwong2 bo3 seon3 hou6 hou2 joek6

rows.note: Use this when “broadcast” means the actual radio or TV programme rather than its transmission.

example.english: I like that morning broadcast best.
example.traditional: 我最鍾意朝早嗰個節目。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ziu1 zou2 go2 go3 zit3 muk6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on disseminating a message widely rather than airing it through a broadcast medium.

example.english: Social media can broadcast this message across Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 社交媒體可以將呢個消息傳播到全港。
example.jyutping: se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 cyun4 bo3 dou3 cyun4 gong2
